title: Lightly Crisp Argentinian Suet Empanadas
description: Rich and crispy empanadas filled with suet, perfect for a snack or light meal, made with halal-friendly ingredients and a delicate fold
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit
In a large bowl, combine the flour, salt, and black pepper
Add the chopped onion, paprika, and beef suet to the bowl and mix well
Gradually add the water and mix until a dough forms
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces and roll each piece into a ball
Roll out each ball of dough into a thin circle
Place a tablespoon of the suet mixture in the center of each circle
Fold the dough over the filling and press the edges together to seal
Brush the tops of the empanadas with the beaten egg
Bake the empanadas for 20 minutes or until lightly golden brown
